reviewNotes: Every domain and bounded contextual regex was compared with the registered incident corpus and historical baseline. The Keyv article's contract differs from the previously approved marker; both are explicitly bounded to the shared NodeReal endpoint and remain WARN context. Historical domain/wallet and older marker provenance is retained; generic Solana, DHT, Calendar, or shared RPC infrastructure alone is not compromise evidence.
scope: Bounded campaign domains and compound executable-context markers; shared infrastructure is not treated as malicious by hostname alone.
supplementScope: Four bounded executable-context endpoint markers, included in the complete bounded dataset review recorded above. No new host is added to the unconditional DANGER domain collection.
